visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun with a white headband and wearing a pink knit sweater faces the camera. She holds a circular black Prada cushion foundation compact, displaying its silver logo. Behind her is a white cabinet filled with various plush toys and dolls. (2) The scene transitions to a medium-full shot of the woman's hand holding a large pink Prada shopping bag, which then moves to a close-up of a pink Prada box on a woven wooden surface. Hands open the box to reveal a black pouch, the cushion compact, and a silver lipstick tube. (3) Returning to the woman's face, she provides close-up views of her cheek and nose area, pointing at skin textures and small spots. She demonstrates the magnetic lid of the Prada compact and uses a black puff to tap the foundation onto the right side of her face. (4) A split-screen comparison shows 'After' on the left and 'Before' on the right, highlighting the coverage. The woman then applies the product to the other side. Later, she is shown with fuller makeup including eyebrows and eye shadow. (5) In a final sequence, she touches her face to check for transfer and displays her skin texture 5 hours later under different indoor lighting, pointing out slight shine on her nose.
